import json,collections
r=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')];a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[7]['slots']['1']='u';a[7]['confidence']['1']='low';a[7]['note']='Slot 1: heavy ink loss obscures the top of the final glyph.'
a[9]['slots']['3']='u';a[9]['confidence']['3']='low';a[9]['note']='Slot 3: final glyph is largely lost; only stem and a small lower fragment remain.'

b=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(b)==len(r)
for src,out in zip(r,b):
 assert src['item_id']==out['item_id']
 keys={str(i) for i in range(1,src['slots']+1)}
 assert set(out['slots'])==keys==set(out['confidence'])
 assert all(x in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for x in out['slots'].values())
 assert all(x in ['high','low'] for x in out['confidence'].values())
 assert out['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
counts=collections.Counter(c for x in b for c in x['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(b),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(counts))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in b))
